title: 宝塚記念の後に・小さな青いバラ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the support of her fans at her back, Rice Shower runs in the Takarazuka Kinen. Although she isn't able to take the win…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She still sees how many people she's made smile. At last, she has become the blue rose she always aspired to be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the race behind her, she decides she wants to run in the Arima Kinen against Mihono Bourbon and Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Like the Takarazuka Kinen, only racers selected by the fans can run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her state her intention to run in such a prestigious race without a hint of apprehension, I can sense how much Rice Shower has grown.
